newsitem.title: USA: State Street says Bank of NY bid denied.
newsitem.headline: State Street says Bank of NY bid denied.

text.p: State Street Boston Corp said on Friday the Massachusetts Board of Bank Incorporation denied Bank of New York Co Inc's application to acquire up to 9.9 percent of State Street's stock.

"We applaud the Board of Bank Incorporation's decision as consistent with the intent of the Massachusetts review process, and reiterate our board's unanimous position that State Street's plan is to remain an independent company," State Street said in a statement.
Bank of New York representatives were not immediately available for comment.
State Street had said in previous announcements that the company is not for sale.
Bank of New York, a bank holding company, announced in January that it wanted to raise its stake in State Street to 9.9 percent from a 4.99 percent stake that it had held as of September 30, 1996.
State Street provides services for management of financial assets.
